name: frustration
quote: I can't figure out how to solve it!
description: The sense that you've been repeatedly blocked from reaching a desired outcome and fear that failure may be near.

variations.name: social frustration
variations.description: The sense that a social goal is being blocked by someone.
examples: I think I deserve employee of the month, but my boss doesn't like me.

variations.name: self frustration
variations.description: A sense that there must be something wrong with your own abilities for not being able to achieve the outcome.

variations.name: bad luck frustration
variations.description: A sense of injustice that you keep getting blocked from a certain outcome by chance events.
examples: This is the fourth time I've had to reschedule the picnic!

variations.name: existential frustration
variations.description: The sense that you just want some measure of satisfaction but don't know how the universe wants you to achieve it.

variations.name: questionable task frustration
variations.description: Being unsure that you can achieve a certain goal while at the same time questioning whether the goal is actually worthwhile.
examples: Do we really have to go through this?

commentaries.quote: Frustration is proportional to the fear of failure.
It is hardly possible to build anything if frustration, bitterness, and a mood of helplessness prevail.
My annoyance became frustration, which became anger, which became hate, and hate is a long-burning fuel.

conditions: A desire to complete a certain goal.
A sense of being repeatedly blocked from reaching that goal after a reasonable amount of effort.
